text:
Predicates:
Likes(x, y) ::: x likes y.
WantsTo(x, y) ::: x wants to y.
HasAccess(x, y) ::: x has access to y.
Can(x, y) ::: x can y.
Compose(x) ::: x composes.
Premises:
Likes(george, music) → WantsTo(george, compose) ::: If George likes music, he wants to compose.
HasAccess(george, program) → Can(george, compose) ::: If George has access to a program, he can compose.
Can(george, compose) ∧ WantsTo(george, compose) → Compose(george) ::: If George can compose and wants to compose, he will compose.
Conclusion:
¬Compose(george) → ¬Can(george, compose) ::: If George will not compose, George can not compose.
